A PRACTICAL GUIDE

How to convert scanned PDF to text

Choose a scanned PDF, enter up to 10 pages, select language and rotation, then recognize text. Correct the preview and download the edited result.

When this tool is useful

Scanned PDFs contain page images instead of selectable text. OCR recognizes those images one page at a time. Use PDF to Word for text-based documents when you want editable font and paragraph reconstruction.

A simple example

Recognize pages 1-3 of a scanned report and download the corrected text as a Word document.

Important limits

Up to 10 selected PDF pages. DPI is capped for device memory. Choose language combinations and review recognized text before saving. Output is text, not a searchable PDF or a faithful document layout.

Frequently asked questions

Are my files uploaded?

No. Document processing runs in your browser. The host receives normal website requests, but these tools do not upload your selected documents to a processing server.

What should I check before downloading?

Up to 10 selected PDF pages. DPI is capped for device memory. Choose language combinations and review recognized text before saving. Output is text, not a searchable PDF or a faithful document layout.
